# PSYCHE

> PSYCHE keeps the record a delivery of contracted compute settles on. SQCD-1, Settlement Quality Compute Data, is PSYCHE's open standard for that record, and anyone holding a record can recompute it.

PSYCHE, at psyche-0.com, issues SQCD-1. Its founder is Fée-Fée Yang, also written Fee-Fee Yang. PSYCHE's email is purr@psyche-0.com.

Contracted compute is GPU capacity rented under a contract that runs for years and pays by the month. Each month the money turns on three facts: what was delivered, whether it met the terms, and whether the buyer accepted it. PSYCHE keeps them as one record per delivery window, called a Case, which both parties sign into and anyone holding it can recompute.

Under SQCD-1, each party files its own signed measurements for every window, and an interval with no observation enters the record as a signed statement. Only the buyer's signed decision, or its delegate's under a grant, produces accepted. Silence ends a Case as expired, under a form both parties chose before the window. Lenders, insurers and auditors read a Case by an access grant one of the parties issued.

## Standard

- [SQCD-1](https://psyche-0.com/sqcd-1.html): the record a delivered compute hour settles on, Version 1.1, 2026-11-10
- [SQCD-1 Recompute](https://psyche-0.com/recompute.html): SQCD-1's worked month recomputed in the browser: each Filing Party's Period Figure under the declared function, the Divergence and the credit quoted on each filing
- [SQCD-1 full standard, PDF](https://psyche-0.com/assets/sqcd-1-settlement-quality-compute-data.pdf)
- [SQCD-1 brief, PDF](https://psyche-0.com/assets/sqcd-1-in-brief.pdf)
- [SQCD-1 schemas, conformance vectors and registry](https://github.com/undiscopurrr/PSYCHE-FOUNDATIONS)

## Delivery settlement

- [The Case](https://psyche-0.com/net.html): the parties around one Case, its seven stops, and each party's job today and with PSYCHE
- [Engage](https://psyche-0.com/engage.html): scopes and fees, including the network fee from the first production deployment: $3 per GPU per month, each side, and $1 for the first 24 months on contracts recorded before the end of 2028

## Paper

- [Signed in Advance](https://psyche-0.com/paper.html): Evidentiary Sufficiency and Settlement Authority in Contracted Compute Delivery, by Fée-Fée Yang, October 2026 ([PDF](https://psyche-0.com/assets/yang-signed-in-advance.pdf))

## Research

- [The acceptance gate](https://psyche-0.com/research-acceptance-gates.html): a clause-by-clause map of ten AI compute customer contracts and two financing arrangements filed with the SEC ([source ledger, CSV, CC BY 4.0](https://psyche-0.com/assets/acceptance-gate-ledger-2026-10.csv))
- [The us-east-1 record](https://psyche-0.com/research-aws-us-east-1.html): the public record of AWS us-east-1, October 2025, read against SQCD-1
